entities.name: Luís de Ataíde, 3rd Count of Atouguia
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: D. Luís de Ataíde, 1st Marquess of Santarém and 3rd Count of Atouguia, was a Portuguese nobleman, military commander and statesman of the 16th century, who stood out for his military feats in the Portuguese State of India. He served as Viceroy of India for two non-subsequent terms.
